request.description: The question bank. Each question fills exactly one attribute from the dictionary. Filters: `status`, `attributeKey`. Staff only. Reading needs question read access (ops lead, compliance, support); changes need question manage access (ops lead, super admin). Changes are audited and published as `question.changed`. Published question sets keep the snapshot they were approved with, so editing a question only affects sets submitted afterwards.
